build.command: docker build --build-arg TARGETOS=linux --build-arg TARGETARCH=loong64 -f internal/dockerfile_hub -t beszel:0.19.0-loong64 .

environment.helper: Native LoongArch64 Debian forky helper with Docker socket; unzip 6.0-31 used to extract the supplied frontend ZIP.

tests.command:
set -eu
image_meta=$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}|{{.Os}}/{{.Architecture}}|{{.Size}}|{{json .Config.Entrypoint}}|{{json .Config.Cmd}}' beszel:0.19.0-loong64)
printf 'IMAGE=%s\n' "$image_meta"
case "$image_meta" in *'|linux/loong64|'*) ;; *) echo 'unexpected image platform' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
docker run -d --rm --name beszel-hub-smoke --tmpfs /beszel_data beszel:0.19.0-loong64
trap 'docker rm -f beszel-hub-smoke >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
docker run --rm --network container:beszel-hub-smoke --entrypoint /bin/sh lcr.loongnix.cn/library/golang:1.27.1-alpine -c 'i=0; until wget -q -T 2 -O /tmp/beszel-index.html http://127.0.0.1:8090/; do i=$((i+1)); if [ "$i" -ge 30 ]; then echo "Hub did not return HTTP 200" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; test -s /tmp/beszel-index.html; grep -qi "<!doctype html" /tmp/beszel-index.html; echo "HTTP 200; HTML bytes=$(wc -c </tmp/beszel-index.html)"; head -c 240 /tmp/beszel-index.html; echo'
docker logs beszel-hub-smoke

build_entrypoints: docker build --build-arg TARGETOS=linux --build-arg TARGETARCH=loong64 -f internal/dockerfile_hub -t beszel:0.19.0-loong64 .
environment_assumptions: Native LoongArch64 Docker daemon; the builder image runs natively and no emulation is used.
Repository-root Docker build context; Dockerfile is at internal/dockerfile_hub.
lcr.loongnix.cn/library/golang:1.27.1-alpine tag must provide the verified Go 1.27.1 LoongArch64 image.
Go module downloads must be reachable during docker build.
The external frontend archive must match the requested Beszel v0.19.0 frontend output.
applicability.runtime: Scratch image with /beszel entrypoint, default serve --http=0.0.0.0:8090, exposed port 8090 and persistent /beszel_data volume.
